answer: Attest the model fingerprint, not the account name, because a name is free and a hash is not. Each agent signs its weights hash and device id, the ledger keeps one slot per fingerprint, and replaying a nonce burns the slot. A plume of 500 clones on one checkpoint resolves to 1 identity. The mirror holds the real count. The cost is re-attesting after every model update, which is the signal you want.
